Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain a numerical two-input, three-hidden, one-logistic-output network with simultaneous forward and gradient-backward views. Exact structure: TWO input nodes → THREE preactivation nodes; each input densely connects to all three; each preactivation through its own ReLU small gate to a corresponding hidden node, THREE hidden nodes → ONE scalar score → sigmoid probability → binary loss. Preactivation and hidden nodes are two views of ONE hidden layer, not two trainable layers. Middle hidden ReLU is inactive: middle hidden node pale gray and its backward gradient path stops at this gate; first and third active paths remain green. Output backward gradient propagates to all three hidden values, then only active ReLU paths pass to preactivations. Use warm red dashed backward arrows in a separate well-spaced lower lane and green forward arrows in upper lane, not overprinted on dense links. Reserve ample blank numeric areas near each of the three neuron rows and a wide bottom summary band for exact derivative vectors. Do not generate digits or formula symbols. No fabricated zero-gradient on the third active node.

Revise THIS fresh numerical backprop draft only. Preserve two forward input nodes, three preactivation/ReLU/hidden nodes and one score/probability/loss pipeline. Fix lower red backward network: the MIDDLE inactive ReLU blocks ALL gradient to its middle green preactivation, so remove the dashed arrow from its gate to middle green circle and remove BOTH red dashed edges from that middle green circle toward the two inputs. Leave the zero-gradient preactivation circle gray with no red outgoing edges. A gradient from score reaches middle hidden value, then stops at this inactive gate, while top and bottom active gates retain paths. Do not remove active gradients. Remove the red X mark (operator will be overlaid if needed), no written text/digits/formulas. Fills are smooth pure pale solids, white background, flat2D.

source_audit.caption: 示例~\ref{ex:ffn-numerical-backpropagation}中$2$-$3$-$1$网络的计算图。上方连线的黑色数字给出前向传递值，红色数字给出相应的反向量；预激活与隐藏表示是同一隐藏层的两种数值，不是两个隐藏层。下方红色虚线按向量形式汇总梯度，坐标顺序与上方节点从上到下一致。第三个单元通过输出权重$0.5$收到梯度，第二个单元的梯度被负半轴上的ReLU截断。数值按更新前参数计算，梯度和概率保留四位小数。

source_audit.reason: 多阶段机制、并行/反馈路径、密集层次或多任务架构，超出少量节点/规则格表的简单图
source_audit.mechanism_brief: 依据正文示例准确呈现两个输入、三个预激活→ReLU隐藏值、一个Logistic二分类输出与交叉熵。前向数值和反向导数分色；第二隐藏ReLU处于负半轴阻断梯度，第三单元经0.5输出权重得到非零梯度；底部按坐标顺序汇总参数梯度。
